title: Figure 4.2: Detail of the Anode and Ion Injection Port in PFX-I (not to scale)
description: Line schematic titled 'ION INJECTION PORT' showing a circular 'Pseudo-spherical well for ion confinement' of radius a, an ion extraction grid with extraction voltage Vext, an ion divertor and electron divertor, and the 'Anode wall (ground)'. Equipotential contour lines labeled E=Eo and E=Emax are drawn; the caption notes the Eo contour determines the region of absolute ion confinement.
